name: Nanami Mina
source:
Nanami Mina is one of [url=/c500]Shuuji’s[/url] classmates. Her parents are busy with work, so she’s the one taking care of [url=/c505]her younger siblings[/url]. She also works part-time at two places. Delivering milk in the morning and as a waitress at Gekka on afternoon. She is a member of the drama club as well. Nanami hates studying, and usually needs to take extra classes because of her low marks. A cute and cheerful class rep, but her attitude isn’t exactly girly.

[Edited from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2010/02/15/asunana-nanami-mina/]Rin's character review[/url].]
